reviews.text:
Version 10.14 shows ALDI doesn't care. Uninstalled.. The ALDI app has seen a steady decline in quality since Version 10.8.

Favorited items that were both easy to add & easy to use when building shopping lists are long gone. They've been replaced by the less-convenient, more-intrusive Shopping List button that takes up screen space when browsing.

There is no longer a native in-app view for ads. From Versions 10.8 through 10.10.0, the app would force you into your default browser to view ads. Now, it just uses WebView to load a watered-down version of Safari within the ALDI app. This is not a native ad in-app view, it's a glorified webpage-within-an-app that offers the worst of both worlds. Want to add an item to your always-in-the-way Shopping List in the app? You can't, because that webpage-within-an-app interface doesn't actually communicate with the app.

The "WeeklySpecials" button still shifts from left to right whenever it's tapped or another bottom menu bar item is tapped instead. This is amateur coding, at best, and should have been fixed before 10.14.0, 10.10.0, 10.8.1, or 10.8 were released.

On a similar note, the ALDI app itself reads as "ALDIGroceryPic..." on the iOS home screen. That highlights both ALDI's careless lack of attention to fundamental app design details (i.e., iOS app names have character length limitations) and the true reason for the changes since Version 10.8.

The ALDI app wants you to use the Shopping List button and then convert your order into a pickup order so that either: 1) you pay them $1.99--formerly $0.00--for someone to bring your order out to your car when you arrive, or 2) you send your order to Instacart so both ALDI and Instacart can pocket even more money from you for delivery fees.

What have you, the consumer, gained since Version 10.8? The "privilege" of having useful features (e.g., favorites, native ads) stripped out while the overall quality (e.g., an always-in-the-way Shopping List button, buggy menu buttons, poorly-formatted app text) has gone down and the overall cost (e.g., $1.99 for curbside pickup, forced to use Instacart for deliveries) has gone up.

ALDI, your iOS app is terrible, and I'm deleting it from my iPhone. I'd encourage any other dissatisfied ALDI app users to do the same.
